ov: A hybrid of a male donkey and a female horse, and more common than the hinny, the reverse cross. Mules are more patient, hardier and longer-lived than horses, and are thought less stubborn and more intelligent than donkeys. They come in any colour a horse or donkey can be.
ht: Up to 180 cm at the withers (large draught mules)
rg: Kept worldwide; in 2018 Mexico had the most, with over 3.2 million.

cf.tip: A mule has a donkey father and a horse mother; a hinny has a horse father and a donkey mother.

fx: Mules have tougher skin than horses and tend to live longer on fewer resources.
Horses and donkeys have different numbers of chromosomes, which is why mules are usually infertile.
notes: The animals.js fact is confirmed (horse × donkey, usually infertile).
